rules.reason: May request application launch through the future mediated launcher interface.
May read only its namespaced settings through the future settings mediator.
General third-party applets may not mutate compositor-owned window state.
The audited shell composition may own the standard registrar and read the authenticated active provider's dbusmenu endpoint.
Menu Event delivery does not grant general compositor window activation authority.
The audited Clipboard applet may observe the bounded metadata-only history projection through its injected client seam.
The audited Clipboard applet may dispatch generation-fenced select, pin, delete, and clear intents; execution stays with the clipboard authority.
Window inventory observation stays with the audited Task List applet; third-party packages have no compositor window read authority.
Window activation stays with the audited Task List applet's generation-fenced intents; third-party packages may not activate windows.
The audited Status Notifier applet may observe the bounded, validated status-item registry through its injected source seam.
The audited Status Notifier applet may dispatch generation-fenced activate, secondary-activate, and context-menu intents; execution stays with the item owners.
The audited Smart Lights applet may observe the bounded luminaire inventory its injected client discovered on the local network.

The audited Smart Lights applet may dispatch capability-validated power, brightness, white-temperature, colour, scene, and preset intents; admission and datagram construction stay with the Wiz client.
The audited Voice applet may observe the bounded org.qindaqt.Voice1 projection, including the live partial the user is dictating, through its injected client seam.
The audited Voice applet may dispatch revision-fenced push-to-talk, finish, cancel, retry, undo and copy intents; opening the microphone and delivering text stay with the voice provider.
Dictation text is the most privileged thing on the desktop at the moment it is spoken. Observation stays with the audited Voice applet.
Opening the microphone is never delegated to a third-party package.
The audited OBS applet may observe what OBS is recording, streaming and sending to the virtual camera, through the loopback control port its injected client holds.

The audited OBS applet may start and stop recording, streaming and the virtual camera and switch scenes; request construction and the control-port credential stay with the injected obs-websocket client.
What a user is recording or streaming, and the scene names they chose, are private; third-party applets have no streaming read authority.
Starting a recording or a stream on the user's behalf stays with the audited applet; a third-party package may not capture the screen or the microphone this way.
Local-network device inventory reveals what hardware the user owns; third-party applets have no smart-light read authority.
Sending datagrams to household devices stays with the audited applet; a third-party package may not actuate the user's lighting.
